decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development shall be completed in the materials specified on the approved plans and within the planning application form, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (MS/SB/33/13MS and one un-numbered perspective drawing received 23/10/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 0700-2300.

Condition : 6 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements for the flats shown on the approved drawing shall be completed in accordance with the details approved under application reference 01031/33/P8(6i) dated 20/09/2012 before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - The car parking shown on the approved drawings shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 8 - The access doorway to the retail unit shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 9 - The details approved under consent 01031/33/P8(9) shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the A1 (retail) unit and maintained throughout the lifetime of the development.
description: Variation of conditions 3 (approved plans) and 4 (fans, ducts and louvres) to allow the development as built to supersede the development as approved in planning permisssion 01031/33/P8 dated 02/12/2011
